cond_0001.intro: Technical Specialist for assembly areas in the General Assembly Department of an automotive manufacturing environment. The role covers preparation of process documents, equipment install/modification before new vehicle launch, monitoring and analyzing current production process, and making improvements in 4M during non-launching periods.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Serve as technical expert of assigned area during vehicle launches
Coordinate and lead project activities, including new equipment installation, supplier selection, and implementation phases
Prepare spec package after reviewing requirements (Quality, Safety, UPH, Layout, Ergonomics etc.)
Communicate with Advanced Vehicle Manufacturing Engineering Team in [Location masked] and other relevant teams in R&D from [Location masked] for successful launch
Host video conference in new vehicle design improvement and status follow up meetings
Responsible for preparation of the Assembly Process Sheets considering method and line condition with detailed picture and text
Work content to be explained through a picture drawn in the workers' position according to work content, work order and work status
Responsible to record the tightening torque from the install drawing after checking the bolt and nut quality from the standard part size. Utilize standard torque chart if install drawing is not available
Determine the Man Hour based on MODAPTS and optimize allocation
Analyze and continuously improve performance of assigned area (safety, quality, production, cost, and human factors)
Participate in Cross Functional Teams (CFT) and other problem solving teams, as directed by Senior Management
Serve as technical expert for Team Members, Team Leaders, including technical training, as required
Support daily production issues as required
Continually review technical developments in area of responsibility and propose new technology projects as appropriate
Prepare presentations/reports on current projects, progress, and issues to management
Understand and control labor allocation
Meet all other requirements as assigned
Administer, coordinate, and comply with all Business Management System (BMS), Environmental Management System (EMS), and Safety Management System (SMS) requirements
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint
0 – 10 Years job related experience in an engineering/industrial environment
Preferred Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in an Engineering discipline or equivalent
Experience in automotive machining processes, tooling capability, and dimensional quality systems
CATIA or similar CAD program

Lead project activities, including new equipment installation, supplier selection, and implementation phases
Prepare spec packages by independently reviewing requirements (Quality, Safety, UPH, Layout, Ergonomics, etc.)

Own preparation of Assembly Process Sheets covering method and line conditions, with detailed pictures and text
Develop work content illustrations from the workers' position, capturing work order and work status

Analyze and continuously improve performance in your assigned area (safety, quality, production, cost, and human factors)

Deliver technical guidance and training to Team Members and Team Leaders as required
Resolve daily production issues as required
Continuously review technical developments in your area and propose new technology projects as appropriate
Prepare and present reports on current projects, progress, and issues to management
Understand and control labor allocation
Meet all other requirements as assigned
Administer, coordinate, and comply with all Business Management System (BMS), Environmental Management System (EMS), and Safety Management System (SMS) requirements

Bachelor's degree in an Engineering discipline or equivalent desired
Experience in automotive machining processes, tooling capability, and dimensional quality systems desired
0 – 10 Years job related experience in an engineering/industrial environment preferred
MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint
CATIA or similar CAD program

cond_0230.intro: We are looking for a New Vehicle Engineering Specialist in the General Assembly for a new Product Launch. This role works within the General Assembly Department of an automotive manufacturing environment, coordinating on process documents, equipment installation and modification before new vehicle launches, and monitoring and improving current production processes during non-launching periods.
cond_0261.responsibilities:
Work alongside the team as a technical resource for assigned areas during vehicle launches
Coordinate project activities together with relevant stakeholders, including new equipment installation, supplier selection, and implementation phases
Help prepare spec packages after reviewing requirements (Quality, Safety, UPH, Layout, Ergonomics, etc.)
Collaborate with the Advanced Vehicle Manufacturing Engineering Team in [Location masked] and other relevant teams in R&D from [Location masked] to support successful launches
Facilitate video conferences for new vehicle design improvement and status follow-up meetings
Work with the team to prepare Assembly Process Sheets covering method and line conditions, with detailed pictures and text
Ensure work content is clearly communicated through pictures drawn from the workers' position, covering work content, work order, and work status
Coordinate with relevant parties to record tightening torque from install drawings after checking bolt and nut quality against standard part size; use the standard torque chart when install drawings are not available
Work with the team to determine Man Hours based on MODAPTS and support allocation optimization
Analyze and continuously improve performance of assigned areas together with the team (safety, quality, production, cost, and human factors)
Participate in Cross Functional Teams (CFT) and other problem-solving teams, as directed by Senior Management
Support Team Members and Team Leaders as a technical resource, including assisting with technical training as required
Help resolve daily production issues as required
Continuously review technical developments in the area of responsibility and share proposals for new technology projects as appropriate
Prepare and share presentations and reports on current projects, progress, and issues with management
Help understand and coordinate labor allocation
Meet all other requirements as assigned
Administer, coordinate, and comply with all Business Management System (BMS), Environmental Management System (EMS), and Safety Management System (SMS) requirements
cond_0261.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in an Engineering discipline or equivalent
MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint
CATIA or similar CAD program
Preferred Requirements:
Experience in automotive machining processes, tooling capability, and dimensional quality systems
0–10 Years of job-related experience in an engineering or industrial environment

The role involves preparation of process documents, equipment install/modification before new vehicle launch, monitoring and analyzing current production processes, and making improvements in 4M during non-launching periods. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of assembly processes and how the different parts of a vehicle launch fit together.
cond_0319.responsibilities:
Serve as technical expert of assigned area during vehicle launches
Coordinate and lead project activities, including new equipment installation, supplier selection, and implementation phases
Need to prepare spec package after reviewing requirement (Quality, Safety, UPH, Layout, Ergonomics etc.)
Communicate with Advanced Vehicle Manufacturing Engineering Team in [Location masked] and other relevant teams in R&D from [Location masked] for successful launch.
Host video conference in new vehicle design improvement and status follow up meeting
Responsible for preparation of the Assembly Process Sheets considering method and line condition with detailed picture and text
Work content to be explained through a picture drawn in the workers' position according to work content, work order and work status.
Responsible to record the tightening torque from the install drawing after checking the bolt and nut quality from the standard part size. Utilize standard torque chart if install drawing is not available
Determine the Man Hour based on MODAPTS and optimize allocation
Analyze and continuously improve performance of assigned area (safety, quality, production, cost, and human factors).
Participate in Cross Functional Teams (CFT) and other problem solving teams, as directed by Senior Management.
Serve as technical expert for Team Members, Team Leaders, including technical training, as required.
Support daily production issues as required.
Continually review technical developments in area of responsibility and propose new technology projects as appropriate.
Prepare presentations/reports on current projects, progress, and issues to management.
Understand and control labor allocation.
Meet all other requirements as assigned
Administer, coordinate, and comply with all Business Management System (BMS), Environmental Management System (EMS), and Safety Management System (SMS) requirements.
cond_0319.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in an Engineering discipline or equivalent desired
Experience in automotive machining processes, tooling capability, and dimensional quality systems desired
0 – 10 Years job related experience in an engineering/industrial environment preferred
MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint
CATIA or similar CAD program
cond_0319.values: We value excellence, achievement, and delivering outcomes we can stand behind. We aim to bring high standards and a results-focused mindset to our work.
cond_0319.workplace_support: We value work-life harmony and recognize that doing your best work should not come at the expense of life outside work. We aim to offer flexibility and support so employees can thrive both professionally and personally.
